[P1] Allow saved callback IDs during completed-child reconstruction

An existing `create_callback()` only reads its checkpointed callback ID, including while its status is `STARTED`. If a large-result child creates a callback and completes with `ReplayChildren`, then its map/parallel branch suspends and resumes within the same invocation, this terminal-only exception rejects that saved callback as orphaned. The coordinator handles `ORPHANED` by exiting and can checkpoint a successful batch with the resumed branch's result missing. Extend replay admission to existing callback checkpoints while retaining guards against new callback creation, and add this callback case to the same-invocation replay tests.
